specimens.name: Standardized black industrial pushbutton
specimens.notes: Black round industrial pushbutton is unlit, unlabeled and mounted in the standardized factory-family bezel.

specimens.name: Standardized green industrial pushbutton
specimens.notes: Green pushbutton matches the black unit family/geometry and is unlit and unlabeled.

specimens.name: Red mushroom emergency-stop
specimens.notes: Red mushroom emergency stop is large and standardized with visible twist/pull reset collar hardware; no text/arrows.

specimens.name: Rotary selector switch
specimens.notes: Rotary selector uses a molded black pointer and three clearly visible physical detent positions around the bezel.

specimens.name: Keyed rotary switch
specimens.notes: Keyed rotary switch has a plain metal key and standardized bezel with no text.

specimens.name: Short industrial control lever
specimens.notes: Short metal control lever has a black molded ball handle and a clearly visible notched detent plate.

specimens.name: Compact industrial joystick
specimens.notes: Compact joystick has a short black handle, rubber bellows/boot and standardized square mounting bezel.

specimens.name: Three-pushbutton station block
specimens.notes: Compact station block holds three aligned unlabeled pushbuttons from one standardized factory family; cap colors differ as functional family variants, accepted by user art direction.

review_method: Exact untouched E1 source was measured and archived to Drive, downloaded back with identical SHA-256/bytes, visually reviewed specimen-by-specimen against the current machine spec/style/era contracts, and compared with exact E0 controls-displays/01-operator-controls candidate SHA 75013d529f538f0fb38844c4228f9d000f9590cb2a36c433aa5d8abeef0aed08. E1 replaces individually fitted toggle/knife/hand-cut control language with standardized pushbutton families, mushroom E-stop, selector/key switch hardware, molded handles/bellows and an aligned multi-button station. User explicitly instructed to fix and accept this corrected sheet after selector detents and lever notches were made visible.
